Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Bracy
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 303 as introduced could reduce reimbursement expenses, per diem and travel, of the Board of Trustees of the Alabama State University by an estimated $159 per member for each board meeting attended virtually pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
